xp_curve_step.label: Levels: XP curve
xp_curve_step.help: XP for the next level is this times (level + 1). 10: level 2 at 20 XP, 5 at 140, 10 at 540.

start_level.label: Test: start at level
start_level.help: For testing; her stats grow with the level.

level_hp.label: Each level: health +
level_hp.help: 6 is a little more than one ghost touch.

level_en.label: Each level: energy +
level_en.help: A swing costs 12, so three levels add one swing.

level_atk.label: Each level: damage %
level_atk.help: Sword hits and specials. 5 makes a Dirge hit of 10 into 12 by level 5.

level_def.label: Each level: less damage %
level_def.help: Enemy hits only, not traps. Never above Defence: most.

def_cap.label: Defence: most
def_cap.help: DEF never goes above this percent.

max_hp_floor.label: Health: lowest maximum
max_hp_floor.help: Even with the COUPLER fitted her maximum health never drops below this.

levelup_refill.label: Level up: refill health, energy and MP
levelup_refill.help: 1 refills all three bars at once; 0 only raises her stats.

area_damage_mult.label: Area enemies: damage times
area_damage_mult.help: Ordinary enemies and their shots. Not bosses and not traps.

xp_respawn_mult.label: XP: enemies that came back times

xp_boss.label: XP: THE PALLBEARER
xp_boss.help: Takes her from about level 4 to 5.

xp_unmuzzled.label: XP: THE UNMUZZLED
xp_unmuzzled.help: Takes her from about level 3 toward 4.

xp_arnetria.label: XP: ARNETRIA
xp_arnetria.help: The last fight of the shift.

suture_heal.label: Suture: heals
suture_heal.help: Eight ghost touches worth of health.

suture_max.label: Suture: most carried
suture_max.help: Only 8 exist in the world and they are never refilled.

coupler_damage.label: COUPLER-034: damage +
coupler_damage.help: Flat damage added to every weapon hit.

coupler_hp.label: COUPLER-034: health change
coupler_hp.help: The price of the extra damage.

governor_hp.label: GOVERNOR-207: health +
governor_hp.help: Raise it if it feels small.

regulator_damage.label: REGULATOR-000: damage +
regulator_damage.help: Flat damage added to every weapon hit, with no price.

cerement_def.label: CEREMENT-112: defence +
cerement_def.help: Percent less damage from enemy hits.

pall_mp.label: PALL-090: MP +
pall_mp.help: One more blade wave's worth of magic.

pall_orb_mult.label: PALL-090: soul orb times
pall_orb_mult.help: 1.5 gives half again the MP from every orb.

tether_scrap.label: TETHER-06: scrap gauge +
tether_scrap.help: How much more scrap she can carry.

tether_repair.label: TETHER-06: health per scrap +
tether_repair.help: Every self-repair tick heals this much more.
